set.n: Norwegian bank-robbery coin under a wood-turning shop, Muskegon
set.pl: Muskegon (city); shop near the Muskegon Lake shore across from the electric light plant, not yet placed
set.st: A Norwegian who died at the county poor farm in Oct 1901 said loot from an 1870 Trondhjem bank robbery was buried under the floor of his little wood-turning shop near a sunken gas pipe, on a strip near the Muskegon Lake shore, then the edge of town, across the street from the electric light plant. From Dec 1902 a man leased the lot and dug 8 ft down under the floors; no find reported. Shop site not yet placed; urban: look-only. Pin is the city point, not the spot itself.
set.t: Place the electric light plant (c.1900 Sanborn) to find the shop strip across the street. Urban: look-only.
src: Twice-a-Week Plain Dealer (Cresco, Iowa) 3 Mar 1903 (TN TreasureNet Treasure Legends - Michigan thread 557882)
